Le patrimoine national algérien au cœur: Algerian national heritage at the heart of an unprecedented art contest
Ooredoo Algérie lance « Born to be DZ –: Ooredoo Algeria launches "Born to be DZ – The Art Contest"
Fidèle à son engagement en faveur de la: True to its commitment to youth and the promotion of Algeria's national heritage, Ooredoo Algeria launched this Tuesday, August 18, 2026, its national contest "Born to be DZ – The Art Contest", an initiative that invites young creators to celebrate, through their works, the cultural, historical, and identity-based richness of Algeria.
Incarné par l’artiste international algé: Represented by the international Algerian artist DJ Snake, this unprecedented contest is part of Ooredoo's desire to highlight Algeria's tangible and intangible heritage while offering Algerian youth a space for expression, creation, and innovation. Participants are invited to draw inspiration from the multiple facets of national identity to propose original works reflecting the cultural diversity, traditions, landscapes, history, and values that make up Algeria's wealth.
Ouvert aux jeunes Algériens sur l’ensemb: Open to young Algerians across the entire national territory from August 18 to September 17, 2026, "Born to be DZ – The Art Contest" is built around five artistic disciplines: Photography, Music, Art & Design, Cinema & Comedy, as well as Dance & Performance. Each candidate is asked to submit an original and authentic creation, inspired by Algerian national heritage and meeting the criteria of the chosen category.
Les candidatures seront évaluées par un: Applications will be evaluated by an artistic jury composed of renowned figures in their respective fields, who will be announced exclusively on Ooredoo's social media channels. The finalists will then be submitted to a public vote via the My Ooredoo application, which will select the five winners of the contest.
Les cinq (05) lauréats, à raison d’un ga: The five (05) winners, at a rate of one winner per category, will each be awarded a prize worth 1,000,000 DZD in recognition of their creativity, talent, and ability to promote Algerian heritage through artistic expression.
Les jeunes passionnés souhaitant prendre: Young enthusiasts wishing to take part in this adventure can now submit their applications online via the dedicated platform borntobedz.ooredoo.dz, where the contest rules, participation terms, and all information regarding the various categories are also available.
À travers « Born to be DZ – Le Concours: Through "Born to be DZ – The Art Contest", Ooredoo reaffirms its commitment to Algerian youth by offering them a true platform to reveal and showcase their talents, while placing Algerian national heritage at the core of artistic expression. Ooredoo thus confirms its role as a corporate citizen committed to promoting Algerian culture and supporting young talent, contributing to the shining recognition of Algeria's rich cultural identity.
